description: Edge Worker improvements: proxy timeout with AbortController, CORS www subdomain + turnstile header, dedicated /health endpoint, env.d.ts PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS, and wrangler.toml comment
steps: Step 1 - Proxy Timeout (apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts): Add an AbortController with configurable timeout (default 30s, read from env.PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS if available). Before the fetch call, create `const controller = new AbortController(); const timeoutMs = parseInt(env.PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS || '30000', 10); const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);`. Pass `signal: controller.signal` to the fetch call. After the fetch resolves, call `clearTimeout(timeout)`. In the catch block, detect AbortError (error.name === 'AbortError') and return 504 Gateway Timeout with JSON body {error: 'Backend request timed out'} instead of 503. Keep the existing 503 for other errors. The function signature already has `env: Env` so use it.

Step 2 - CORS improvements (apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts): Add 'https://www.syrabit.ai' to the ALLOWED_ORIGINS array. Add 'x-turnstile-token' to the Access-Control-Allow-Headers string (comma-separated list currently has 'Content-Type, Authorization, CF-Turnstile-Response').

Step 3 - Edge health endpoint (apps/edge/src/index.ts): In the routing section (section 5), BEFORE the existing check `if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/health'))`, add a specific check: if url.pathname === '/health', return a direct JSON response {status: 'healthy', service: 'syrabit-edge', timestamp: new Date().toISOString()} with status 200 and Content-Type application/json. This means only /health is handled at the edge; /health/deep and /api/v1/health still proxy to backend. Adjust the existing condition to still proxy /health/deep to backend.

Step 4 - Env type (apps/edge/src/env.d.ts): Add an optional PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS field to the Env interface: `PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS?: string;` with a comment explaining it overrides the default 30s proxy timeout in milliseconds.

Step 5 - Wrangler config comment (apps/edge/wrangler.toml): In the top-level [vars] section, add a comment above AZURE_BACKEND_URL explaining that this localhost value is for local dev only; in production it MUST be set as a Wrangler secret via `npx wrangler secret put AZURE_BACKEND_URL --env production`.
acceptance_criteria: apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts uses AbortController with 30s default timeout and returns 504 on timeout vs 503 on other errors
apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts ALLOWED_ORIGINS includes https://www.syrabit.ai and Allow-Headers includes x-turnstile-token
apps/edge/src/index.ts returns direct JSON health response for exactly /health without proxying
apps/edge/src/env.d.ts has optional PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS?: string in Env interface
apps/edge/wrangler.toml has clarifying comment about AZURE_BACKEND_URL production requirement
TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) passes with no errors in apps/edge/
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in apps/edge/ directory to confirm TypeScript compiles without errors
findings: All 5 steps implemented successfully. TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) passes with zero errors after npm install in apps/edge/. The package-lock.json was generated during install but not committed as it is not part of the feature scope.
